LESSON: FOOD SOURCES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.1: Food sources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Food sources

• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

• Use safe examples only.

• Safe action connected to Food sources.

Try this

• Write 5 bullet facts about Food sources.
• Say one safety rule.
